source: Statements of aim. Verbatim lines are from the research statement; drafts await Bishesh's approval.

title.text: I want flood warnings in Nepal to reach people in time, and to send them somewhere they can still get to.
title.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

quote.text: A warning only helps if it arrives with enough time and the routes people need are still open.

body.text: My work tries to close that gap. Hydraulic models show where the water will go, and machine-learning surrogates make them fast enough to warn from. Exposure and route analysis then show who gets cut off and where they can still reach shelter.
body.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

Rain.text: Design storms and warning thresholds are only as good as what we know about rainfall extremes.
Rain.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

River.text: Every flood warning starts with a forecast of how much water the river will carry.
River.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

Flood.text: Counting buildings in a floodplain is not enough, because loss of access matters too.

Warning.text: Hydraulic models are too slow for real-time warning. A surrogate that answers in seconds can run each time new rain data arrives.
Warning.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

People.text: A map of who is exposed, and of which shelters stay reachable, turns a warning into an evacuation plan.
People.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

hanumante-ews.text: I want the Hanumante's flood warning to carry the physics of a full 2D model at the speed a warning needs. Trained on the model's own runs, the surrogate returns discharge at every cross-section in seconds.
hanumante-ews.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

bagmati-evacuation.text: Counting buildings in a floodplain is not enough, because loss of access matters too. This work asks which neighbourhoods are cut off in a large flood and how the way out changes, so that evacuation plans and shelters go where people can still reach them.
bagmati-evacuation.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

kaligandaki-preprint.text: Most of Nepal's rivers have few gauges. Knowing when a machine-learning model can stand in for a process-based one, and why, decides how far flood forecasting can reach into those basins.
kaligandaki-preprint.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm

floodhub.text: Few valleys in Nepal have a calibrated hydraulic model. FloodHUB gives planners a first map of where flood risk concentrates and where people could shelter, built from open data they can check.
floodhub.source: draft 2026-10-12 in Bishesh's voice, TODO: confirm
